retro:
# PR #12800 retrospective

## What worked

Fresh verified Fable High and Astra Xhigh sessions received equivalent neutral assignments and separate evidence directories. Both completed independent reports before peer conclusions were shared. JSON argv capture and downstream forwarding exposed a meaningful whitespace boundary missed by line-oriented ordinary-input tests. Coordinator rerun and Fable's explicit post-final correction resolved the difference without overwriting history. All reviewed-code tests fit command-only isolation; no desktop capacity was needed.

## Friction and improvements

- Fable's first diagnostic run failed to apply two mutations due to fixture quoting. The report clearly invalidates those rows and uses the corrected second run. Future mutation fixtures should assert the exact before/after text before running tests.
- Fable's baseline URL case backgrounded the recording process, producing out-of-order sections. Use per-case JSON paths and explicit completion signals when checking code known to interpret `&`.
- Do not infer universal round-trip safety from internal-space controls. Add trailing-space and all-space arguments whenever testing shell serialization.
- A harmless Fable scratchpad printf/glob probe ran outside review.py and was removed. Keep even builtin semantic probes inside the assigned fixture for uniform provenance and to avoid safety-boundary ambiguity.
- The surviving app-ID mutation is real but lower priority than the demonstrated production mismatch. Keeping it local made the public comment more useful.

## Tool issues

No confirmed review.py, Herdr or Omadev bug. No Omadev session was required. The initial failed mutation was a fixture error, not a tool bug. Organizational report separation worked, but is not OS-enforced confidentiality.

## Cleanup and carry-forward

Both reviewers reported completed cleanup. Sandbox runtimes and temporary homes terminated, no host processes/services were started, and both source checkouts remain clean. Preserve historical sessions, original reports, follow-up, scoped archives and seals. Future reviews should keep the same independent-final gate and targeted adjudication discipline. This PR's conclusions must not carry into the next fresh team sessions.
comment:
One argument-preservation edge case remains at `ec2440d4`: trailing spaces can still merge adjacent arguments. This is an incomplete fix to an existing problem, not a regression in the inspected shipped callers.

**Verified:** Ordinary spaced arguments, literal shell metacharacters, explicit empty arguments, and query-string URLs survive the tested launch path. The new regression test passes all eight checks at head and rejects the baseline.

| Input | Baseline | PR head |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `"two words"` | Two arguments | One unchanged argument |
| `'https://chat.example/?a=1&b=2'` | URL truncated at `&` | Full URL preserved |

### Trailing spaces still change argument boundaries

The wrappers now serialize argv with `%q`, but [`omarchy-launch-or-focus:18`](https://github.com/omacom/omarchy/blob/ec2440d4843cc45f0e9e0760888985582b6e9bce/bin/omarchy-launch-or-focus#L18) expands `$LAUNCH_COMMAND` unquoted before `eval`. That first word-splitting step collapses the escaped trailing space and the separator.

Synthetic reproduction through the real wrappers, recording argv at the `setsid` boundary:

```text
omarchy-launch-or-focus-tui mytui 'trailing ' sentinel

Expected: ["mytui", "trailing ", "sentinel"]
Observed: ["mytui", "trailing sentinel"]
```

**Impact:** Custom callers with meaningful trailing spaces can lose an argument boundary, including a following flag. Both TUI and webapp wrappers reproduce this; a final trailing space instead becomes a literal backslash. No inspected shipped caller uses this shape, and baseline already mishandled it.

**Suggested change:** Pass the serialized string intact to `eval`:

```diff
-  eval exec setsid $LAUNCH_COMMAND
+  eval exec setsid "$LAUNCH_COMMAND"
```

A disposable diagnostic copy restored all five trailing-space cases, retained the tested controls, and passed the existing eight checks. Add final and nonfinal trailing-space assertions, since the current test passes despite this mismatch.

---

## Review information

**Test scope:** Pinned baseline/head scripts with mocked window and process-launch boundaries. No real terminal, browser, compositor or UWSM integration was exercised. The documented change from splitting a custom single-string command to preserving one argument is intentional.

**Community review:** Independent automated community review, unaffiliated with the Omarchy team, intended to help prepare PRs for their review.

**Automated AI review:** Astra initial inspection, independent Fable 5.1 and separate Astra reviews, followed by targeted evidence verification and a coordinator rerun of the trailing-space reproduction and diagnostic correction.
